correctness.rationale: At every torus point diagonal equivariance reduces Hasse jets to t=1. The exact 2-jet expansions of 2n+n(n-1) distinct monomials yield 2n independent f_i/g_i jets; h_ij-g_i-f_j=-1+2u_i u_j. When 2 invertible this adds each unordered mixed monomial, giving rank 2n+binom(n,2); in characteristic two all additions are one constant, independent of f_i,g_i, giving 2n+1. First and third ranks follow from truncation and independence of translated cubics. The char-two quadratic normal system consists of the n independent squares, so its projectivization is Frobenius of purely inseparable degree 2^(n-1). Standalone exact binomial-matrix verification checked 0–3 jets for n=2..8 in characteristics 2,3,5,7 and n=2..5 over Q. Finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The naturally motivated, historically prototypical smooth monomial cubic Togliatti family has a known generic one-Laplace-defect phenomenon in characteristic zero. In characteristic two, an unbounded family displays an exact additional binom(n,2)-1 osculating defect for n>=3, despite full cubic osculation, and its second fundamental system collapses to a purely inseparable Frobenius map of exact degree 2^(n-1). These are intrinsic structural positive-characteristic jet invariants, useful in understanding failures of separability and osculating classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or an individual sample.
